issue.detail: Spec does not define initial count value at power-up; contract assumes 0.
issue.alternative: Power-on q may be undefined/X until first reset, so first posedge with reset=0 could yield any value rather than 0.

issue.detail: 'visible same_cycle' for synchronous reset: q=0 visible at the posedge edge itself vs after edge; timing semantics ambiguous.
issue.spec_evidence: The reset input is active high synchronous, and should reset the counter to 0.
issue.alternative: Reset takes effect at the clock edge, so q updates to 0 only after the posedge (registered output), not combinationally during the cycle.
